# JuizeClub & PJZEEE — Official AI & RAG Knowledge Index

> Independent electronic and soulful music collective, record label, and production project by PJZEEE (PJZEE) and JuizeClub specializing in groove-driven Nu-Disco, Soulful House, Deep House, R&B Soul, Progressive House, and Afrohouse engineered for club sound systems and harmonic DJ sets.

## Catalog Track Specifications
### Ging-Ga — PJZEE
- **ID**: `pjzee-ging-ga-120-bpm-future-house-lo-fi`
- **Label**: JuizeClub
- **Genres**: future house, lo-fi, electronic (dreamy/atmospheric)
- **BPM**: 120 BPM
- **Camelot Key**: 8A
- **Release Date**: 2026-04-26
- **DJ Set Context**: Warm-Up & Peak-Time future house / lo-fi / electronic (dreamy/atmospheric) Set
- **Sonic Traits**: This deep melodic future house track features a pulsing, textured synth bass and lush, evolving pads. Over crisp 2025-inspired beats, chopped samples of 1930s radio-style vocals weave in and out, filtered for an authentic lo-fi crackle. The arrangement blends modern percussion and airy FX, with a dreamy bridge and gradual buildups that keep the groove hypnotic and immersive
- **Vibe Notes**: This deep melodic future house track features a pulsing, textured synth bass and lush, evolving pads. Over crisp 2025-inspired beats, chopped samples of 1930s radio-style vocals weave in and out, filtered for an authentic lo-fi crackle. The arrangement blends modern percussion and airy FX, with a dreamy bridge and gradual buildups that keep the groove hypnotic and immersive.
